scene1_screen1.text: The hotel lobby buzzes with low chatter and clinking glasses from the nearby bar. Velvet armchairs dot the room, and the scent of orchids lingers in the air like a quiet flirtation.

scene1_screen2.text: Two guests arrive at the front desk at the exact same time. Emily, chic but clearly travel-worn, drops her bag with a tired sigh, brushing a stray lock of hair behind her ear.

scene1_screen3.text: Liam, casual with a glint of mischief in his eye and a travel camera slung over one shoulder, steps up beside her with an easy smile that suggests he’s already decided this is the best thing to happen to him today.

scene1_screen5.text: Liam Foster. Also 312... (pause, mock-serious) Either we’re married and no one told us... or fate just got very creative.

scene1_screen6.text: Their eyes meet, brows raised. A beat of surprised amusement hangs between them. he receptionist stiffens, already dreading the chaos she sees forming.

scene1_screen8.text: She gives a guilty wince and clicks furiously at her keyboard, mumbling something about upgrades and apologies.

scene1_screen9.text: The storm grounded three flights, and our system glitched from all the last-minute bookings. I’m so sorry — but we’ve overbooked. Room 312 is the last one available.

scene1_screen10.text: A long pause. The weight of the situation sinks in — one room. Two strangers. No backup plan.

scene1_screen11.text: Emily rocks back slightly on her heels, whistling low under her breath, as if impressed by the absurdity of it all.

opts.text: Be practical — agree to deal with it.
Be playful — make the best of it.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen1.text: You can’t be serious… There has to be some room — supply closet? Manager’s office?

scene1_choice1_option1_screen2.text: The receptionist fumbles with the system again, clearly panicking. Liam leans casually on the counter, tossing a sympathetic glance toward the poor girl.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (grinning) Maybe they’ll bunk me in the kitchen. I do make a mean omelet under pressure.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen4.text: After a few tense clicks, the receptionist looks up, defeated.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen5.text: I’m truly sorry. Between the tech convention and that influencer wedding upstairs... we’re out of space.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen7.text: (cheerfully) Hey, could be worse. At least you’re not stuck with a guy who quotes bad poetry or travels with a lizard.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen8.text: The receptionist, still apologetic, hands them a dinner voucher and gestures toward the restaurant.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen9.text: At the very least, let us make it up to you with something delicious. The chef makes a killer risotto.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen10.text: Emily exchanges a glance with Liam, still unsure. He gives her a theatrical, mock-solemn nod, as if pledging honor in battle.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen11.text: Fine. But I’m ordering dessert out of spite.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen12.text: (grinning) Make it two. We’ll turn this disaster into a culinary revenge plot.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen13.text: They head toward the restaurant — still strangers, but already slipping into an easy rhythm. Like two improvisers thrown onto the same stage.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Emily exhales slowly, pinching the bridge of her nose. Beside her, Liam taps thoughtfully on the counter, as if weighing imaginary pros and cons.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen2.text: Alright. I’ll survive one night. (half-smiling) But I’m claiming the side of the bed with the lamp.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (nodding solemnly) Fair trade. I snore very attractively — like a sexy bear on a hiking trip.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen4.text: They exchange a half-smile — more amused than annoyed. The kind of smile that says: "Well... at least we’ll have a story."

scene1_choice1_option2_screen5.text: The receptionist quickly slides a dinner voucher across the counter.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen6.text: Please, enjoy dinner on us. The kitchen’s still open for another hour.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen7.text: Emily takes the voucher and glances sideways at Liam, who pretends to inspect it like a fine wine label.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen8.text: Might as well get fed before we’re forced into bedtime negotiations.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen9.text: (grinning) Table for two awkward almost-strangers, please.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen10.text: They walk off together, the strange tension of the situation fading under the warmth of their growing rapport.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Emily lifts a brow and offers her hand with a mischievous smile.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen2.text: Well, hello, roommate. I’m Emily. I call dibs on the pillow with more fluff.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (accepting her hand with exaggerated formality) Liam. Photographer of sunsets and collector of terrible hotel stories. I call dibs on not being murdered in my sleep.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Their handshake lingers a beat longer than necessary, sparking a flicker of curiosity. Liam’s thumb brushes the side of her hand lightly before he lets go — barely noticeable, but enough.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen5.text: The receptionist, now visibly relieved at their rapport, slides a dinner voucher across the counter.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen6.text: It’s on the house. And I promise — no surprises on the menu.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen7.text: (grinning) First dinner, then survival planning. I’ll even let you choose the escape route in case things go horror movie.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen8.text: (laughing) Sounds like a terrible plan. Lead the way.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen9.text: They walk side by side toward the restaurant, a shared buzz of anticipation trailing behind them like the first notes of a reckless new song.

scene2_screen1.text: Candlelight flickers between them as Emily and Liam are seated at a quiet corner table with a skyline view. Soft jazz weaves through the air, and the night outside glows with the pulse of city lights.

scene2_screen2.text: A waiter brings over two glasses of champagne. Liam lifts his glass with a sideways glance.

scene2_screen3.text: To accidental evenings.  (raising his glass slightly) And surprisingly good company!

scene2_screen4.text: Emily clinks her glass to his, her smile cautious but intrigued.

scene2_choice1.text: How do you steer the conversation?

opts.text: Break the ice with a playful game.
Keep it real — try to get to know her.
Get a little bold — suggest making the night unforgettable.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Liam sets down his glass, a spark lighting his eyes.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Let’s play a game — three facts about you — two true, one lie. I’ll guess.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (raising a brow) What do I get if you’re wrong?

scene2_choice1_option1_screen4.text: (grinning) Winner picks dessert... and gets to choose which of us has to sleep under the ugly hotel throw blanket.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen6.text: Alright. 1 — I once climbed a volcano barefoot. 2 — I hate sushi. 3 — I’ve ghosted someone after a first date.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen8.text: (smiling) You? Ghost someone? Never. You look like the type who’d politely finish dessert before running.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen10.text: Wrong. Volcano hike — boots. Ghosting — very real. Crypto bro. Forty minutes straight. No survivors.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen11.text: They both laugh — real laughter, easy and warm, slicing through any remaining awkwardness.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Liam studies her for a beat, his voice softer now.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen2.text: What were you actually hoping tonight would be, before the hotel turned it into a romcom setup?

scene2_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (honestly) Room service. Face mask. Bad TV. Zero human interaction

scene2_choice1_option2_screen4.text: She chuckles, but her gaze stays steady on him.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen5.text: But... I’m not mad about the change of plans.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen6.text: (tilting his head) Even with a stranger who might steal your side of the bed?

scene2_choice1_option2_screen7.text: (grinning) Especially with a stranger who makes me forget it was supposed to be a lonely night.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen8.text: A warmth creeps into the air between them — subtle, but unmistakable.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Liam leans forward slightly, voice dropping.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen2.text: If this really is the universe screwing with us...  (pause, teasing) Maybe we owe it to fate to do something crazy.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen4.text: (low, playful) Something that makes this night impossible to forget.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen5.text: Emily traces the rim of her glass, weighing him — the dare in his tone, the glint in his eye.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen6.text: Guess we’ll see if you live up to the hype, stranger.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen7.text: Liam’s smile deepens, slower now, more deliberate — like he’s decided on something and is daring her to follow. Without breaking eye contact, he slides his hand across the table, palm up, open.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen8.text: (soft, inviting) Come with me. No questions. No second thoughts.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen9.text: For a heartbeat, Emily hesitates — her fingers still circling the rim of her glass, the hum of the crowded restaurant fading into the background. Something in his voice — low, earnest, real — tugs at her chest, unsettling and magnetic all at once. Her pulse kicks up, reckless.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen10.text: (half-smiling, teasing, but her voice softer) You always this good at getting strangers into trouble?

scene2_choice1_option3_screen11.text: (grinning, but there's a flicker of something deeper) Only when it feels like it’s meant to be the good kind.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen12.text: She hesitates, then slips her hand into his, a spark jolting through them. His fingers close around hers, steady and sure. Around them, the world blurs — and for the first time tonight, Emily feels exactly where she belongs: with a stranger whose touch feels dangerously familiar.

scene2_screen5.text: Their conversation is cut short when a shadow falls across their table. A man in a sleek suit — charming, polished — steps closer. His gaze fixes on Emily with a smile that doesn't quite reach his eyes.

scene2_screen7.text: Emily instantly freezes at the sight of her ex-boyfriend, her fingers lightly gripping the base of her glass.

scene2_screen9.text: (smirking) Didn’t expect to see you here. New... friend?

scene2_screen10.text: Before Emily can respond, Nathan leans in conspiratorially.

scene2_screen11.text: I’m actually on my way to propose tonight.  (smiling too wide) Guess some of us move on faster than others, huh?

scene2_screen12.text: He winks, tosses a casual "good luck" over his shoulder, and disappears toward another table where a woman is waiting.

scene2_screen13.text: Emily stares after him, the color draining slightly from her cheeks. She blinks fast, fighting the sting of old wounds reopening.

scene2_screen14.text: Liam watches her quietly, reading every tiny flicker of emotion. And then he moves — without hesitation, without overthinking.

scene2_screen16.text: He signals the waiter for another two glasses of champagne, then stands up and drops onto one knee in front of Emily.

scene2_screen17.text: The restaurant falls into an expectant hush. All eyes swivel toward them.

scene2_screen18.text: (voice clear, confident, playful) Emily Carter... From the second we fought over that hotel room, I knew. You’re the disaster I want to survive every day with.

scene2_screen19.text: A ripple of laughter runs through the room. Phones lift discreetly. Champagne flutes clink. Emily covers her mouth, part shock, part helpless laughter.

scene2_screen20.text: Liam lifts her hand gently, pretending to slip an invisible ring onto her finger. The crowd bursts into warm applause.

scene2_screen21.text: Emily leans down and whispers, laughing through unshed tears.

scene2_screen23.text: (grinning up at her) Worked, didn’t it?

scene2_screen24.text: He stands, and for a beat, they just look at each other — something shifting, something deeper threading between them.

scene2_screen25.text: They slide back into their seats amid cheers and clinking glasses. Two fresh glasses of champagne are placed before them, along with a small "Congratulations!" note from the waiter.

scene2_screen26.text: Their laughter fades into a quieter, softer energy. The restaurant around them hums back to life, but for Emily and Liam, the world feels a little more distant now — like a glass dome enclosing just the two of them.

scene2_screen27.text: They linger over the last sips of champagne, the empty plates forgotten. Outside, the city glows like scattered embers against the night sky.

scene2_screen28.text: (leaning in, voice low, teasing) Getting a little stuffy in here, huh? How about some fresh air after a proposal like that?

scene2_screen29.text: He tilts his head toward the elevators. Above them, a soft glow catches Emily’s eye: “ROOFTOP VIEWING DECK — OPEN UNTIL MIDNIGHT.”

scene2_screen30.text: Emily’s smile lights up, effortless and sure.

scene2_screen31.text: (grinning) I have a feeling the stars owe us something tonight.

scene2_screen32.text: Without hesitation, she slips her hand into his and tugs him toward the elevators, laughter still bubbling in her chest.

scene2_screen33.text: The elevator hums upward, thick with the scent of rain and something electric building between them.

scene3_screen1.text: When the elevator doors slide open, the city stretches out like a glittering carpet. The rooftop is empty — just the two of them, under string lights and stars.

scene3_screen2.text: Emily steps out first, hugging herself against the cool breeze. Liam follows, fiddling with the camera in his hands — not to show off, but like an instinct he can’t resist.

scene3_screen3.text: (grinning) You're going to make the skyline jealous if you keep standing there like that. By the way, someone says that I'm a good photographer, do you want me to prove it?

scene3_screen4.text: Oh, really? Well, as a just-engaged fiancée, I demand photographic evidence!

scene3_screen5.text: Emily laughs, a breathless sound, and spins slowly — the city lights catching in her hair like sparks.

scene3_screen6.text: (teasing) Oh? Should I pose dramatically? Maybe drape myself over the railing? "Paint me like one of your French girls" kind of vibe?

scene3_screen7.text: (barking a laugh) Tempting. But if we do that, someone’s definitely calling security.

scene3_screen8.text: He lifts the camera — not asking, just instinctively, like it’s the most natural thing in the world.

scene3_screen10.text: The shutter clicks. Emily tucks a curl behind her ear, half laughing, half blushing under his gaze.

scene3_screen11.text: (deadpan) Incredible! I see it now: Album cover: Songs to Make Questionable Decisions To.

scene3_screen12.text: (giggling) Only if you're the backup dancer in the video.

scene3_screen13.text: He clicks again — capturing the exact moment her laughter spills into the night. The world feels lighter. The city hums far below, but here, it’s just them.

scene3_choice1.text: How do you take the moment?

opts.text: Flirt more boldly — close the distance.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Liam lowers the camera and gestures at the view.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Serious question: Do you think somewhere down there, there's a couple making out in the back of a car, Titanic-style?

scene3_choice1_option1_screen3.text: (smiling wide) Statistically? Definitely. Romantically?  (smirk) Kind of glad we have a rooftop instead of steamed-up windows.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen5.text: They drift closer, shoulders brushing, a soft thrum building between them. The rooftop hums with the laughter they don’t voice and the tension they don’t quite name.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen6.text: As the night air grows colder, Liam bumps her shoulder lightly.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen7.text: (smiling) Come on! Let’s take this Titanic sequel somewhere with central heating!

scene3_choice1_option1_screen8.text: Emily laughs, threading her fingers lightly into the crook of his arm as they walk back toward the elevator. Neither rushes. Neither needs to.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Liam sets the camera down gently, stepping into her space — close enough that she can feel the heat of him.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (soft) If this were a movie... (pause, voice low) This would be the part where I steal a kiss under the stars.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (tilting her head, playful) And if it’s not a movie?

scene3_choice1_option2_screen4.text: (whispering) Then maybe it’s even better. Because this... ...this feels real.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen5.text: His fingers skim her wrist — featherlight — inviting rather than taking. Emily’s breath catches, but she doesn’t pull away. Instead, she leans in until their foreheads almost touch.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen6.text: Their shared smile says everything words can’t.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen7.text: Eventually, Liam pulls back slightly, his voice soft.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen8.text: (grinning) Come on! Before the rooftop gets jealous!

scene3_choice1_option2_screen9.text: Emily threads her fingers through his, and together they head back to the elevator, the city fading behind them, but the night is far from over.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Without a word, Liam lifts the camera one last time — not to photograph her, but to tuck it aside carefully, almost reverently.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen2.text: He steps into her space — no rush, no demands — just a closeness crackling between them.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (hoarse whisper) Forget memories. I want something we don’t need to capture to remember.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Emily’s breath stutters, but she doesn’t step back. Instead, she meets him halfway — brave, steady, daring.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen5.text: His hand brushes her cheek — slow, reverent — tracing the curve of her jaw, the line of her neck.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen6.text: (whispering, teasing) We’ve been engaged for, what, ten minutes? And you're already acting like a husband.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen7.text: Liam chuckles low against her skin, the sound more vibration than voice.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen8.text: (grinning, soft) Just trying to be an overachiever.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen9.text: His touch deepens — sliding from her cheek to the back of her neck, pulling her closer. Their lips meet — slow, hot, a kiss full of wonder and longing.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen10.text: Emily melts into him, her fingers fisting lightly in his jacket, pulling him even closer.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen11.text: The kiss deepens, teeth grazing lips, breath stolen and given back. The world tilts deliciously off-balance.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen13.text: When they finally break apart, they’re both flushed, laughing softly against each other’s mouths.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen14.text: (breathless, teasing) At this rate, we’re going to need a "Just Married" sign before breakfast.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen15.text: (grinning) Too late. Pretty sure the rooftop’s already our witness.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen16.text: Liam brushes a final kiss to her forehead — gentle, grounding — before taking her hand and leading her back toward the elevator.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen17.text: The stars blur behind them. The city hums below. But all that matters is the quiet, burning connection between their fingers.

scene4_screen1.text: The door swings open with a soft click. Inside, warm golden light spills across polished wood floors, one large bed still perfectly made, a small sitting area by a wide window framing the night skyline.

scene4_screen2.text: Emily steps inside first, her hand trailing lightly along the edge of a table, almost as if grounding herself. Liam follows, tossing his jacket over a chair, his smile smaller now, more real.

scene4_screen3.text: Outside, the city is still awake. Inside, it’s just them — and the choice of what this night will become.

scene4_choice1.text: How do you shape the night?

opts.text: Keep it light — explore each other’s quirks.
Create something unforgettable — a secret dare.
Give in to the pull — something deeper

scene4_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Emily kicks off her shoes with a grin and flops dramatically onto the bed, arms wide.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (cheerfully) Alright, confession time: One totally ridiculous thing about you... And if it’s good enough, I’ll share mine.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Liam laughs, walking over and sitting at the edge of the bed.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen4.text: (pretending to think hard) I still sleep with one foot sticking out from under the blanket. Every night. Can’t stand being fully tucked in.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen6.text: She rolls onto her side, propping her head up on her hand.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen7.text: My turn: I talk to plants...  (pause, mock-serious) And they listen better than most people!

scene4_choice1_option1_screen8.text: They trade small, ridiculous truths late into the night — laughter weaving between them like thread — until it’s not just attraction anymore. It’s something warm. Safe. Real.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (grinning) Let’s make a deal. One dare. One you’ll remember every time you think about tonight.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen2.text: Liam leans in, intrigued, resting his elbows on the table.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen4.text: (teasing) You’re still here. Means you’re at least a little dangerous yourself!

scene4_choice1_option2_screen5.text: She leans closer, voice dropping low enough that only he can hear.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen7.text: Liam chuckles under his breath but obeys, shutting his eyes, a smirk playing on his lips.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen8.text: Then — a feather-light brush of her fingers against the back of his hand, then along his wrist. Just enough to leave a trail of heat behind.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen9.text: Liam’s breath catches slightly, the smile faltering into something rawer. He keeps his eyes closed — trusting her, daring her.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen10.text: (whispering) First rule of tonight’s dare: you can’t look... but you’ll never forget.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen11.text: She traces a small invisible shape — a heart? an X? — into his skin, then pulls back just as he opens his eyes. Her expression is unreadable, playful and daring all at once.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen12.text: (soft, a little hoarse) Your move, then.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen13.text: And just like that, the air between them crackles — not from a touch they can see, but from one they can still feel long after it’s gone.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Emily steps closer, brushing her fingertips over the camera strap still loose around Liam’s neck.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (softly) Maybe some moments shouldn’t be captured at all.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen3.text: Liam reaches up, gently taking the camera from her and setting it aside — carefully, as if the moment itself is fragile.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen4.text: When his hands return, they find her sides — not pulling, just anchoring. Her breath hitches for a moment, but she doesn’t move away.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen5.text: He doesn’t rush. His gaze lingers on her face. One hand lifts to cup the side of her face, thumb brushing her cheekbone with infinite care.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen6.text: She leans in — not shyly, not boldly, but like it’s the most natural thing she’s ever done. Their kiss unfolds slowly, soft and sure, like a page turning in a long-unwritten story.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen7.text: They move together — not directed, not spoken — guided by instinct and softness. The room around them dims, or maybe it’s just that the rest of the world stops mattering.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen8.text: Between kisses, there’s laughter — breathless, unsure, and bright. Her hands find his. His forehead presses to hers.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen9.text: What follows is not hurried. It’s quiet. Certain. The kind of closeness that doesn’t demand, but welcomes. It feels earned — every touch a whispered vow: You’re safe here. You’re wanted.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen10.text: When they are finally lie still, the room is filled with the quiet hum of shared breath and wild hearts finally, blessedly, at rest.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen11.text: Outside the window, the first hints of dawn creep across the skyline.

scene5_screen1.text: Soft light spills across the hotel room. The city is still blurred by early morning mist, the world holding its breath in that perfect, delicate pause between night and day.

scene5_screen2.text: In the bed, the covers are tangled in happy disarray. Emily stirs first, blinking slowly, disoriented in that way that only comes after a night that feels like a movie you’re not sure you starred in — or dreamed.

scene5_screen3.text: Beside her, Liam is still asleep, one arm draped lazily across her waist, his breathing steady and deep. He looks different in sleep — younger, softer, like all the quick wit and playful bravado have folded away, leaving only the boy underneath.

scene5_screen4.text: Emily watches him for a long moment, warmth curling in her chest. This was supposed to be a disaster. It turned into... something else. Something a little too perfect.

scene5_screen5.text: (whispering to herself, smiling) Married for one night and already stealing the blankets.

scene5_screen6.text: The phone buzzes softly on the nightstand — a text from the front desk reminding them of checkout times. Reality tapping at the edges of their little private world.

scene5_screen7.text: Emily smiles wider. Not yet. Not just yet.

scene5_choice1.text: How do you say goodbye to this perfect night?

opts.text: Keep it light — make it a beautiful memory.
Make a memory worth blushing over

scene5_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Emily gently runs her hand down Liam's arm.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (whispering) Thanks for the best fake honeymoon a girl could ask for.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen3.text: She slips carefully out of bed, scribbles something on a hotel notepad — a messy little thank you and a doodle of a crooked heart — and leaves it by his camera.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen4.text: By the time Liam stirs awake, she’s already gone — just a wisp of laughter lingering in the rumpled sheets and the golden morning light.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Emily shifts closer, her hand smoothing over Liam’s chest.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (softly) If this is a movie... I vote for an extended ending.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Liam stirs, blinking up at her — and when he sees her smile, he smiles back, slow and unguarded.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen4.text: (voice rough with sleep) Thought you'd never ask.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen5.text: They stay curled together, exchanging terrible jokes about being "honeymooners in hiding".

scene5_choice1_option2_screen6.text: Outside, the city moves on. Inside, they let time slow to a crawl just a little longer.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen7.text: After a couple of hours, they still had to part and who knows when life will bring them together again.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Emily props herself up on one elbow, hair a tousled halo against the pillow, and grins down at Liam.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (playful) You know, for a guy who proposed after knowing me for, what, three hours... you make a pretty decent fake husband.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen3.text: Liam blinks sleepily, then smirks, voice low and rough.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen4.text: (smirking) Give me another hour, and I’ll have you demanding real vows!

scene5_choice1_option3_screen5.text: Emily laughs — a rich, warm sound that curls between them like smoke. She trails a finger lazily down his chest, tracing random patterns on bare skin.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen6.text: (teasing) Another hour? Ambitious. Most grooms don’t even survive the morning after.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen7.text: Liam catches her wandering hand and lifts it to his lips, brushing a kiss to her knuckles.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen9.text: Before she can reply, he tugs her gently down on top of him — slow, teasing — until she's straddling him, her hair falling around their faces like a curtain.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen10.text: The air between them shifts. What was teasing becomes tender. Charged.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen11.text: (murmuring) Warning: this is the part where the fake honeymoon gets an... extended cut.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen12.text: Emily leans in until their noses brush, her smile wicked and soft all at once.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen13.text: (whispering) Then I’m all in for the bonus content.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen14.text: Their mouths meet — slowly, then deeper, each kiss unfolding like a memory in the making.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen15.text: They move together in perfect rhythm, laughter and quiet sighs threading through the space between them. Time slips, but they don’t notice.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen16.text: No rush. No fear. Only the beautiful recklessness of two people who know this moment will never be repeated exactly the same way again.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen17.text: Hours — or maybe minutes, or maybe a lifetime — later, they finally collapse back into the pillows, breathless and tangled in soft laughter.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen18.text: Emily picks up Liam's camera from the bedside table and takes a quick, blurry photo of them tangled in the sheets, a messy but perfect memory that only they will see.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen19.text: She tosses the camera back onto the chair, grabs the hotel notepad, and scrawls a message.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen20.text: (smiling) Since we’re apparently terrible at normal timelines...  (beat) Give me your number, husband!

scene5_choice1_option3_screen21.text: Liam scribbles his number messily under her words, adding a crooked heart.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen22.text: They exchange the paper like co-conspirators.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen23.text: When Emily finally steps out into the hallway, hair messy, heart lighter than it’s been in years, her phone buzzes almost instantly.

scene5_screen8.text: Whatever last night meant, this moment feels different. And sometimes the only way to know what it truly means is to stay close and keep talking. The next chapter is yours — continue the story together in chat.
